github_phase: Phase 4 - Complete bounded similarity screening and split integrity

source.reference_fingerprint_method: SHA256 of sorted (relative_path|raw_file_sha256) lines, as in Phase1 manifest V2

grouping.rule: Union of prefixed filename-series CANDIDATES, SHA256 file/decoded exact duplicates, and strong within-original-train perceptual candidates
grouping.train_deduplication: remove redundant decoded-pixel-exact copies from original train only; maintain all original test rows

validation.method: StratifiedGroupKFold selected on original train only

near_duplicate_screen.method: Exhaustive 64bit pHash Hamming screening, then actual 96px image-structure comparison
near_duplicate_screen.note: All 0..6 pHash candidates will be compared; HIGH/REVIEW are not confirmed duplicates.

resume_from_previous_phase4.if_unavailable: full audit from images, with progress reporting
resume_from_previous_phase4.identity_check: previous full inventory file SHA matched Phase 1; current paths match; candidate source bytes are reverified before scoring
